title: John Deere S100 17.5 HP GAS 42 in. Hydrostatic Riding Lawn Tractor
description:
John Deere S100 17.5 HP Gas 42” Hydrostatic Riding Lawn Tractor
The
John Deere S100
is a rugged, reliable, and easy-to-operate riding lawn tractor that brings power and precision together for effortless lawn care. Built for homeowners who demand performance and quality, the S100 is powered by a
17.5 horsepower engine
and features a
hydrostatic transmission
that makes driving smooth and intuitive.
With a wide
42-inch cutting deck
, this mower is perfect for handling medium to large lawns efficiently, while the
Edge™ Cutting System
ensures a cleaner and more consistent cut. Designed for both durability and comfort, it features a high-back seat, ergonomic controls, and a fully welded steel frame. It also supports mulching, bagging, and side discharge—making it a complete lawn care solution out of the box.
Key Features
17.5 HP Briggs & Stratton Engine
– Delivers reliable performance with easy starts.
42″ Stamped Steel Deck
– Offers efficient coverage and precision cutting.
Hydrostatic Transmission
– Smooth operation with foot pedal controls.
Edge™ Cutting System
– Optimized for superior grass lift and cut quality.
Adjustable High-Back Seat
– Ensures operator comfort during long sessions.
Full-Length Welded Steel Frame
– Designed to endure years of use.
Easy Maintenance
– Quick-access oil change system and open engine bay design.
Specifications
Engine Brand
: Briggs & Stratton
Engine Power
: 17.5 HP
Cutting Width
: 42 inches
Cutting Height Range
: 1″ – 4″ (13 positions)
Transmission
: Hydrostatic, Rear-Wheel Drive
Forward Speed
: Up to 5.5 MPH
Reverse Speed
: Up to 3.2 MPH
Turning Radius
: 18 inches
Fuel Tank
: 2.4 gallons with gauge
Seat
: High-back, adjustable
Deck Engagement
: Manual PTO
Lighting
: Front headlights included
Tire Size (Front/Rear)
: 15″ x 6″ / 20″ x 8″
Mulch & Bagger Capable
: Yes
Dimensions
: 69.7″ L x 55.2″ W x 42.5″ H
Weight
: Approx. 436 lbs
Warranty
: 2-Year / 120-Hour Full Coverage Warranty
What’s Included
John Deere S100 Lawn Tractor (fully assembled)
42” Twin Blade Mower Deck
Rear bagger attachment
Mulching kit
Pre-installed seat and wheels
User manual & setup guide
Built-in headlights
Pre-filled engine oil & battery
All required accessories & tools
Own the Yard with Confidence
Whether you’re upgrading from a push mower or simply want to mow smarter, the
John Deere S100
offers exceptional performance, convenience, and value. From weekend warriors to first-time riders, this machine is built to make mowing faster, easier, and more enjoyable.
Take control of your lawn with the John Deere S100 — where power meets comfort, and your lawn meets perfection.
